prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Constructing Your Companion's Habitat", "Your pet is getting comfortable while we set up its home workspace.", "Setting up desktop roaming area", "Ambient Habitat Audio"]
1: ["Meet Your Future Desktop Companion", "Select an archetype that best fits your workflow and personality.", "Select Companion Archetype"]
2: ["Bringing Your Pet to Life", "Listen to your companion's voice preview while background assets load.", "Listen to Voice Preview", "Estimated generation time remaining"]
3: ["Master Desktop Controls", "Learn how to move, minimize, and summon your pet on your desktop toolbar.", "Try Desktop Control"]
4: ["Signing in secures your companion data so your pet never gets lost or reset.", "Automatic Cloud Protection Enabled"]
5: ["Review Custom Pet Photos", "Ensure high resolution and clear lighting for the best render result.", "Confirm & Continue"]
6: ["Your Companion is Ready on Desktop", "Use these quick gestures and tray icons to interact with your pet anytime.", "Click pet to chat, drag to reposition, right-click for options."]
7: ["Preparing Your Pet's Personality", "While your companion generates, check out these fun ways to interact once setup finishes.", "Tip: Right-click your pet to open quick commands"]
8: ["Choose How You Want to Create Your Desktop Pet", "Pick a ready-to-adopt companion or upload photos to build a custom friend in seconds."]
9: ["Upload High Quality Photos", "Use well-lit front-facing photos for optimal 3D pet generation.", "Clear face lighting & single pet subject"]
